lines: An apology is a seed. It still needs watering, and I will be watching the crop.
Break a fence and you mend it before night. Trust works much the same.
You stepped on trust like young shoots. It can grow back if you stop trampling it.
I hear the apology. What you do next will tell me how much it weighs.
Thank you for saying it plainly instead of hiding behind an excuse.
I am willing to move forward, but I will not pretend nothing happened.
Give me a little time and keep your word in the meantime.
The harm is done. Your apology can still change what follows it.
I accept that you regret it. Repairing it will take longer.
Do not promise everything. Start by doing one thing properly.
I would rather see changed behavior than hear a finer speech.
You came back to face me. That matters more than you know.
I am still angry, but I am listening now.
We can mend this if neither of us pulls at the break.
I will not use your mistake forever if you do not repeat it.
The village has enough grudges. I do not want to grow another one.
Your words reached me. Let your actions catch up to them.
I can forgive without forgetting what needs to change.
All right. We begin again carefully, not blindly.
I accept your apology. Treat that trust better this time.
